crossRefs.note: Of Moab. Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Woe to Nebo! For it is laid waste. Kiriathaim is disappointed. It…
“You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up…
The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.
I will stretch out my hand on them, and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout…

people.name: Diblathaim
people.line: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings.

people.name: Dibon
people.line: Moabite city, allotted to Gad, later possessed by Moab.

people.name: Nebo
people.line: A city and mountain in Moab
